rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for shaking off a person, problem, or unwanted thing.

example.english: I finally rid myself of that annoying salesperson.
example.traditional: 我終於甩咗個煩人嘅推銷員。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 lat1 zo2 go3 faan4 jan4 ge3 teoi1 siu1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when someone frees themselves or another person from a troublesome situation or burden.

example.english: I finally rid myself of this heavy burden.
example.traditional: 我終於擺脫咗呢份沉重嘅負擔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 baai2 tyut3 zo2 ni1 fan6 cam4 cung5 ge3 fu6 daam1

rows.note: Use this when you actively remove an unwanted person or thing, rather than merely freeing yourself from it.

example.english: We need to rid the office of this pile of rubbish.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zing2 zau2 ni1 deoi1 laap6 saap3

rows.note: Use this specifically when getting rid of someone or something by driving it away.

example.english: The caretaker rid the balcony of the birds.
example.traditional: 管理員趕走咗露台啲雀。
example.jyutping: gun2 lei5 jyun4 gon2 zau2 zo2 lou6 toi4 di1 zoek3
